newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Q1 state income 88 bln pta above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Spain Q1 state income 88 bln pta above forecast.

text.p: Spain's Secretary of the Exchequer Juan Costa said on Friday state income in the first quarter had been 88 billion pesetas higher than forecast in the budget, Costa's spokeswoman confirmed.

The income will allow the government to reach its state deficit targets for 1997 and meet the Maastricht deficit criterion, he said in Gran Canaria where he was meeting delegates from the regional government.
Spain has budgeted for a total 1997 income of 16.1 trillion pesetas.
The Maastricht criterion requires that member countries should aim at a government deficit of no more than three percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
